appear-flip-quick.description: A card flipping over quickly, landing with a light tap.
pour: A card flipping to reveal its back
eviter: Things that simply slide or fade (a whoosh suits those)

appear-materialise.description: Something materialising: particles gathering in and settling.
pour: An element appearing out of particles
A product or idea taking shape
eviter: Things that simply slide or fade (a whoosh suits those)

pour: Praise for a person or a team
A small win or a milestone
A presentation or a demo ending
eviter: Serious or sensitive moments
On top of speech: it's busy

celebration-popper.description: A party popper: a sharp pop and streamers rustling out.
pour: A new feature or milestone unveiled
eviter: Serious or sensitive moments
On top of speech: it's busy

click-tap-soft.description: A soft fingertip tap on glass.
pour: A finger tapping a card or tile
Selecting an item on a phone screen
eviter: Moments that need to be noticed over music
Mouse clicks (use mouse)

data-countup-short.description: A short count-up: ticks that speed up and settle, about 0.6 seconds.
pour: A statistic counting up to its value
A price or total adding up
eviter: Counts much longer than the run: use the next length or a count tick per step

data-number-land.description: A woody knock with a small, bright ping: a number landing.
pour: The final number of a count-up landing
eviter: Things that aren't data (use whooshes, pops or shimmers)

digital-scan-subtle.description: A soft scan: a gentle tone gliding up with slow pulses.
pour: Scanning a document, face or code
A progress sweep or a search
eviter: Natural, physical subjects (use foley, impacts or whooshes)
Moments that must cut through music (use clear)

impact-light-firm.nom: Impact, light, on a firm surface
impact-light-firm.description: A light wooden tap: a small object set down on a table.
pour: Small elements landing or snapping into place
eviter: Big, heavy moves

money-coin-drop.description: A coin dropped on a table: it rings, bounces and rattles flat.
pour: A saving or a small payment
Tips, change, a coin of the realm
One coin landing on a graph or pile
eviter: Abstract money moments that are better as a chart or a number (use data sounds)

money-register.description: A cash register: a key, the bell's ching and the drawer sliding open.
eviter: Abstract money moments that are better as a chart or a number (use data sounds)

move-bounce.description: A rubber ball bouncing to rest: bonk, bonk, bonk-bonk-bonk.
pour: A ball, a dot or a character bouncing
eviter: Serious or corporate scenes

move-zoom-in.description: Zooming in: air rushing nearer and rising to the moment it arrives.
pour: Zooming into a detail or a screen
eviter: Small, subtle moves (use a soft whoosh)

notification-message-in-soft.description: A little bubble and a warm note: a new message.
pour: A new notification on a phone
eviter: Sending (use message out)
Moments that must cut through loud music (use clear)

notification-success-soft.description: A warm, rising three-note marimba arpeggio: done.
pour: A task completed or a form submitted
eviter: Errors or warnings
Moments that must cut through loud music (use clear)

pop-small-in.description: A tiny, bright pop that lifts as it appears.
pour: Elements appearing or scaling up into view
Icons, badges and stickers popping in
eviter: Things leaving the screen (use pop out)
Big shapes

pop-small-out.description: A tiny, soft pop that drops away.
pour: Removing an item from a list
eviter: Things arriving (use pop in)
Big shapes

props-page-turn.description: A page turning: lifted at the corner, swung over and falling flat.
pour: Turning to the next page or chapter
Moving on to the next step
eviter: Abstract ideas better shown with a UI or motion sound

props-shop-bell.description: A shop door bell: a small brass bell jingling on its spring.
pour: A customer walking into a shop
eviter: Abstract ideas better shown with a UI or motion sound

riser-1s-soft.description: A 1-second soft, airy rise that builds to its peak at the end.
pour: Building up to a reveal: a logo, a product, a big number
A short lift before something appears
eviter: Reveals that land before the rise ends: the peak is at its end
Big, energetic moments (use strong)

shimmer-short-soft.description: A short shimmer: a few soft, glassy glints that ring out gently.
pour: Gentle highlights: a feature, a benefit, a tick
Elements lighting up or being highlighted
eviter: Negative or serious moments

sting-warm-short.description: A warm marimba sting: a quick roll up into a rich, rounded chord.
pour: A logo at the end of an explainer
A logo that appears at once
eviter: Mid-film transitions: a sting says 'ending' or 'brand moment'
On top of speech: time its hit to a pause in the voice

swipe-medium-soft.description: A soft fingertip swipe across a screen.
pour: Swiping a card across in an app demo
eviter: Objects flying through the air (use a whoosh or swish)
Moments that need to cut through music (use firm)

time-clock.description: A clock ticking: tick, tock, once a second.
eviter: Moments that need no sense of time

time-stopwatch.description: A stopwatch: a click to start, fine ticking, a click to stop.
eviter: Moments that need no sense of time

tone-ding-mid.description: A small bell's clear ding (C, middle).
pour: Highlighting a key point, a feature or a benefit
A tick, an answer or a result appearing
eviter: Errors or warnings

whoosh-fast-soft.description: A quick, gentle puff of air with a soft edge and no weight.
pour: Small icons or text sliding in
Tooltips, chips and small UI panels moving
List items arriving one after another (at a lower gain)
eviter: Heavy objects
Big scene changes

whoosh-medium-soft.description: A smooth, gentle sweep of air that rises and fades without an edge.
eviter: Snappy, quick moves
Energetic edits

writing-highlighter.description: A highlighter swept across a line of text.
pour: Highlighting a key line or number
eviter: Typed text (use keyboard)
Loud moments: it's a quiet, close sound

writing-marker-draw.description: A marker on a whiteboard, drawing a few long strokes.
pour: Lines, arrows, shapes and diagrams being drawn
eviter: Typed text (use keyboard)
Loud moments: it's a quiet, close sound

writing-pen-tick.description: A pen on paper, ticking a box.
eviter: Typed text (use keyboard)
Loud moments: it's a quiet, close sound
